title: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.21232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. translated_title: 一种生成式AI驱动的全屋智能服务架构：边缘模型、记忆管理与家庭应用
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能正在进入家庭。基于云的助手在数据传输治理、持续可用性以及物理动作可靠性方面存在局限，这在家庭场景中尤为突出——家庭中的设备始终保持在线、数据随时间不断累积、命令会触发真实世界的动作。本文以家庭本地服务器作为统一的组织轴心，构建了一个面向设计的综述框架。研究检索了截至2026年11月来自arXiv、CNKI、ACL Anthology及官方文档的文献资料，并将其编码为五类证据：综述、系统原型、基准测试、人机交互与养老研究、官方文档。研究将各类系统设计映射到共享的架构模块上，识别出家庭本地服务器的九项反复出现的职责。生成式模型支持感知解释、意图理解和候选方案规划，而确定性有效的方法则[摘要截断]……
tldr: 本文以家庭本地服务器为核心组织轴心，通过面向设计的系统性综述构建生成式AI全屋智能服务架构，识别出本地服务器的九项核心职责，以解决云端助手在数据治理、持续可用性和物理动作可靠性方面的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a generative AI-driven whole-home intelligent service architecture organized around the home local server, identifying nine recurring responsibilities through a design-oriented systematic review to address cloud-based assistants' limitations in data governance, continuous availability, and physical action reliability.
